item.title: What to know as Trump visits Xi in China
item.description: Trump has landed in Beijing for the first visit by a US leader since his own in 2017.

item.title: Trump arrives in China for high-stakes meeting with Xi Jinping
item.description: The leaders of the global superpowers are expected to discuss the war in Iran, tariffs, AI and Taiwan during the two-day visit.

item.title: Russian drone attacks kill 13 in Ukraine after ceasefire expires
item.description: Attacks are continuing after Ukraine's president warned of "more waves" of Russian strikes throughout Wednesday.

item.title: Israeli strikes on cars in southern Lebanon kill 12, health ministry says
item.description: Two children are among those reported dead after seven cars were struck in separate attacks south of Beirut.

item.title: Trump's 'Golden Dome' will cost $1.2tn and might not stop all-out missile attack
item.description: That pricetag is nearly seven times higher than Trump's initial estimate, found an independent budget office.

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.
